headline: Iran War Odds Through 2026
status: Iran's security chief said Tehran is no longer responding to Washington and warned that regional cables and data centers would be hit if fighting resumes, while the IRGC now says ships crossing Hormuz with tracking switched off will be treated as hostile. Another outbound tanker was hit by an unidentified projectile and a burning tanker's 22 crew were rescued off the UAE, but none of these hits carries a named Iranian claim, so no tripwire fired and the odds hold. "War by Nov. 3" needs a confirmed Iranian claim or a US strike, and stays at 55%. Houthi strikes shut Riyadh's main airport again.

bets.cond: Iran accepts US sequencing, or round two is set with text
Iran ends strait tolls and permits, or declares Hormuz open to all shipping
Iran offers a concrete cut in enrichment capacity, in text or on the record
